cases.answer:

| Aspect | Giga | Sola |
|--------|------|------|
| **Title** | Software Engineer I / II | Software Engineer, Backend |
| **Location** | New York, NY | New York, NY |
| **AI-Focused** | Yes | Yes |

| **Application Status** | Applied 2026-10-01 | Applied 2026-10-08 |

**Key Differences:**
- **Salary**: Sola has a higher ceiling ($300K vs $250K) but a lower floor ($150K vs $160K)
- **Skills Focus**: Giga emphasizes full-stack development and NLP, while Sola focuses on distributed systems and infrastructure (Kubernetes, DynamoDB, Temporal)
- **Experience**: Giga explicitly requires 1+ years; Sola has no stated requirement
- **Tech Stack**: Sola specifies Python and TypeScript, while Giga is more infrastructure/integration-focused
